title: Mimu Oyamada Ends Lovestruck Prince! I'll Fight the Heroine for My Villainess Fiancée! Manga
content: Mag Garden 's Mag Comi website published the final chapter of Mimu Oyamada 's manga adaptation of Shakushineko 's Lovestruck Prince! I'll Fight the Heroine for My Villainess Fiancée! ( Betabore no Kon'yakusha ga Akuyaku Reijō ni Saresō nanode. ) light novel on August 18.
author: ANN

title: Boruto’s Return From Hiatus Makes a Beloved Character’s Fate Even More Dangerous
content: The Boruto series has been thriving since its second installment, Two Blue Vortex , began serialization in August 2023, with new chapters released every month for the next three years. However, in August 2026, the series finally took a break for its third anniversary, quietly celebrating the milestone.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Quest Game Series Sells 100 Million Units
content: Square Enix announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday its Dragon Quest game series has reached over 100 million units in sales cumulatively with physical and digital sales. The company shared a video with Dragon Quest creator Yūji Horii celebrating the news.
author: ANN

title: Official Naruto Shippuden Battle Board Game Launches Crowdfunding Campaign
content: Board game studio This is a GAME and publisher Don't Panic Games launched a project on the Gamefound crowdfunding platform on Wednesday for their new board game Naruto Shippūden Battle .
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Expands Cast Ahead of Fall Debut
content: The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime adaptation making its debut later this Fall, and it’s expanding its voice cast roster with a new update ahead of its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: 31 Years Later, Legendary Isekai Reboot Sets Crunchyroll Release Date – Watch Trailer
content: It’s been over thirty years since Magic Knight Rayearth’ s original TV anime series came to an end, and Crunchyroll has revealed when you will be able to stream its new anime reboot when it premieres.
author: ComicBook

title: Snack World Reloaded Game's Trailer Previews Combat, Stages, Bosses
content: Level 5 unveiled for Tokyo Game Show on Wednesday a gameplay trailer for Snack World: Reloaded , a remake of its Snack World: The Dungeon Crawl - Gold ( The Snack World : Trejarers ) game, and it previews enemy combat, stages, and boss fights: The game will launch in 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC…
author: ANN

title: Bleach’s Final Season Reveals English Dub Release Date for Hulu Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has announced it is taking a hiatus before returning for its final episodes this Fall, and the anime has set an official release date for its English dub finale with Hulu.
author: ComicBook

title: Decapolice Game's Trailers Preview Story, Mysteries, Combat
content: Level 5 began streaming for Tokyo Game Show on Wednesday two trailers for the DECAPOLICE crime suspense role-playing game . The first video previews the story, and the second highlights the gameplay, including mystery-solving and combat: DECAPOLICE will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in…

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game's Video Previews Opening, Showbiz, Combat
content: Sega unveiled during a livestream for Tokyo Game Show on Wednesday a new video for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century"), and it shows about 10 minutes of the game's beginning, including the opening credits sequence.
author: ANN
